NAME:
   rancher delete - Delete resources

USAGE:
   rancher delete [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   amazonec2config, amazonec2configs:                                          Delete the amazonec2config
   azureconfig, azureconfigs:                                                  Delete the azureconfig
   certificate-rotation, certificaterotations, certificate-rotations:          Delete the certificate-rotation
   clusterroletemplatebinding, clusterroletemplatebindings, crtb:              Delete the clusterroletemplatebinding
   configmap, configmaps, cm:                                                  Delete the configmap
   cronjob, cronjobs:                                                          Delete the cronjob
   daemonset, daemonsets, ds:                                                  Delete the daemonset
   deployment, deployments, deploy:                                            Delete the deployment
   digitaloceanconfig, digitaloceanconfigs:                                    Delete the digitaloceanconfig
   encryption-key-rotation, encryptionkeyrotations, encryption-key-rotations:  Delete the encryption-key-rotation
   etcd-snapshot-restore, etcdsnapshotrestores, etcd-snapshot-restores:        Delete the etcd-snapshot-restore
   etcd-snapshot-save, etcdsnapshotsaves, etcd-snapshot-saves:                 Delete the etcd-snapshot-save
   gitrepo, gitrepos:                                                          Delete the gitrepo
   globalrolebinding, globalrolebindings:                                      Delete the globalrolebinding
   harvesterconfig, harvesterconfigs:                                          Delete the harvesterconfig
   helmop, helmops:                                                            Delete the helmop
   horizontalpodautoscaler, horizontalpodautoscalers, hpa:                     Delete the horizontalpodautoscaler
   ingress, ingresses, ing:                                                    Delete the ingress
   job, jobs:                                                                  Delete the job
   k3k-cluster, k3kclusters, k3k-clusters:                                     Delete the k3k-cluster
   kubeconfig, kubeconfigs:                                                    Delete the kubeconfig
   limitrange, limitranges, limits:                                            Delete the limitrange
   managedchart, managedcharts:                                                Delete the managedchart
   management-token, managementtokens, management-tokens, v3token, v3tokens:   Delete the management-token
   namespace, namespaces, ns:                                                  Delete the namespace
   networkpolicy, networkpolicies, netpol:                                     Delete the networkpolicy
   oidcclient, oidcclients:                                                    [Prime] Delete the oidcclient
   persistentvolumeclaim, persistentvolumeclaims, pvc:                         Delete the persistentvolumeclaim
   pod, pods, po:                                                              Delete the pod
   poddisruptionbudget, poddisruptionbudgets, pdb:                             Delete the poddisruptionbudget
   project, projects:                                                          Delete the project
   projectroletemplatebinding, projectroletemplatebindings, prtb:              Delete the projectroletemplatebinding
   provisioning-cluster, provisioningclusters, provisioning-clusters:          Delete the provisioning-cluster
   replicaset, replicasets, rs:                                                Delete the replicaset
   resourcequota, resourcequotas, quota:                                       Delete the resourcequota
   secret, secrets:                                                            Delete the secret
   service, services, svc:                                                     Delete the service
   serviceaccount, serviceaccounts, sa:                                        Delete the serviceaccount
   statefulset, statefulsets, sts:                                             Delete the statefulset
   storageclass, storageclasses, sc:                                           Delete the storageclass
   token, tokens:                                                              Delete the token
   user, users:                                                                Delete the user
   vmwarevsphereconfig, vmwarevsphereconfigs:                                  Delete the vmwarevsphereconfig

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --project string            the project, by id or display name, on the cluster given by --cluster (only commands that take --project accept it)
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
